summary_en: Post-adjustment settlement of Accelerated Share Repurchase (ASR) tranche 1 confirmed: acquisition of 514,400 shares through warrant cancellation, calculated as the difference between 35,347,250 shares purchased at average VWAP of 2,078.3112 yen and 34,832,900 shares sold.
title_en: Notice of post-adjustment settlement in Accelerated Share Repurchase transaction
translation_en_brief: On November 19, 2026, Seven & i Holdings announced the completion of post-adjustment settlement for the first tranche of its Accelerated Share Repurchase (ASR) transaction. Under the adjustment mechanism, the company acquired 514,400 shares without compensation from warrant holders. This number was calculated as the difference between 35,347,250 shares purchased at an average VWAP of 2,078.3112 yen and 34,832,900 shares sold by SMBC Nikko Securities. The average VWAP was computed as the arithmetic mean of daily volume-weighted average prices from August 4 through November 18, 2026, multiplied by 100.55%, with certain exclusion periods for quarterly settlement dates and market disruption events. The 23rd series warrants involved in this adjustment lapsed without exercise upon settlement of the post-adjustment.
